verse: You were running a good race. Who has kept you from obeying the truth? The God who chooses you does not keep you from obeying the truth. You should know that just a little yeast works its way through the whole batch of dough. The Lord makes me certain that you will see the truth of this. The one who has gotten you all mixed up will have to pay the price. This will happen no matter who has done it.
